question: Why does the review on water quality in photocatalytic hydrogen production say that low-emission hydrogen already makes up about a quarter of global hydrogen production?
expect: premise false: Table 1 gives a low-emission share below 1%; nearly 95% is still fossil-based (Table 1; Introduction)
rendered: The review does not say that low-emission hydrogen already makes up about a quarter of global hydrogen production. In fact, it states that low-emission hydrogen accounts for less than 1% of total production, according to the International Energy Agency (IEA).
